subject: Seat redistribution & feature portability request — Avaelle Health
messages:

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Seat reallocation question — Avaelle

Hi Jonas,

Quick question as we prepare for a product reorg: we need to move ~30 seats that are currently assigned to the Premium tier over to the Core tier for a subset of teams (we're not reducing headcount, just reassigning entitlements). Contract runs through 2028-02.

Two things we need clarified before we commit:
- Can you port feature entitlements (realtime routing and burst pools) from Premium seats to Core seats mid-contract? If not, what are the remapping options?
- How do you handle proration / credits on our seat billing when seats move between tiers mid-term? Any impact to our discounted pricing band?

Attached is a quick rollup of our current seats and usage. We also may want to add a short mutual action plan so procurement can sign off quickly.

Can you outline 1–2 recommended paths and the expected timing (and any one-time fees)?

Thanks,
Karin
Karin Lewis
Head of Procurement, Avaelle Health
Attachment: Avaelle_MA_2027_Q2.xlsx
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Karin Lewis <karin.lewis@avaellehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Seat reallocation question — Avaelle

Hi Karin — thanks for the note and the spreadsheet. I've reviewed the rollup and sketched two practical paths below; I'll loop in Kim and Priyom for technical and pricing validation.

Option A — Seat reallocation (preferred if you want immediate change):
- Reassign 30 seats from Premium -> Core. Core will receive the seats but will not inherit Premium-only entitlements automatically.
- For entitlements that are Premium-only (realtime routing), we can attach a feature license to specific Core seats for a temporary period (60 days) while you finish the org swap.
- Billing: seats will be billed at Core tier rates pro‑rated from the change date. Any discount band tied to total seat count remains evaluated on the overall committed seats (so no immediate band drop if total seats stay same).
- Timeline: 3–5 business days for the change + feature mapping. No downtime.
- One-time migration fee: $0–$2,000 depending on whether we need to run config scripts for realtime routing mapping.

Option B — Seat credit + feature pool (preferred if you want to keep Premium entitlements intact):
- Move seats logically to Core and issue a seat credit from Premium that can be consumed against a feature pool (realtime routing / burst) for 6 months.
- Billing: Premium seats that we credit reduce billed count; Core seats billed at Core rate. Proration applied at the daily level.
- Timeline: 5–7 business days.
- One-time migration fee: $2,500 (for pool provisioning + access controls).

I'll let Kim and Priyom validate the entitlements and confirm estimated fees. If either option looks promising I can draft a short MAP and a proposed amendment for signature.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 13:29:00 -0700

Jonas — quick technical clarifications from Product Ops:
- Realtime routing is a Premium entitlement by default and requires config change when attached to Core seats. We can enable it per-seat but it requires a short validation window (usually 24–48 hours) to ensure routing policies don't collide with existing Premium pools.
- Burst pools (token-based) can be shared across tiers but must be tied to an account-level pool; the token burn rates differ by tier. If Avaelle wants feature parity, we recommend Option B with a 6‑month pool so usage patterns can be observed.
- No data migration is required, just entitlement remapping.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Product Operations | Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Seat reallocation question — Avaelle

Sales Ops notes and commercial proposal:
- Confirmed current ARR for Avaelle with Redwood: $180,400. Current committed seats: 420 (Premium 180, Core 240). Moving 30 seats Premium->Core doesn't change total seats.
- Discount banding: bands are evaluated on committed seats monthly; since total stays 420 there is no automatic band change. However, because the mix shifts away from Premium (higher unit price), list-equivalent ARR will drop by ~$3.6k annually. We should offer a commercial concession to avoid churn risk.

Proposal A (low-friction):
- Implement Option A (reassign + attach entitlements) with no migration fee if Avaelle signs the MAP within 7 business days.
- Offer a one-time credit equal to 8% of the ARR delta from the tier move (~$288) applied as invoice credit.

Proposal B (conservative):
- Implement Option B (seat credit + feature pool). Charge $2,500 for pool provisioning.
- Offer a temporary 12% discount on any additional capacity purchased as part of this amendment (applies to new seats only, 6 month term).

Ask: Ben, can you confirm whether finance can approve the 8% one-time credit for Proposal A?

—Priyom
Senior Sales Operations Analyst | Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Seat reallocation & next steps — Avaelle

Karin — thanks for the quick turn. Summary and recommended next steps below (short MAP attached to the HubSpot deal).

Summary of options:
- Option A (fast): reassign seats, attach Premium entitlements to Core seats temporarily, prorate billing at Core rate, one-time migration fee waived if MAP signed in 7 business days. We offer an 8% one-time credit to offset list-equivalent ARR delta.
- Option B (feature pool): issue seat credit + create a 6-month feature pool for realtime routing & burst; $2,500 provisioning fee; 12% discount on any added capacity tied to this amendment.

Recommended: If your immediate priority is continuity of entitlements for 2–3 teams, choose Option A. If you'd like to measure usage and avoid per-seat entitlement changes, choose Option B.

Next steps if you pick Option A:
1) Reply to this thread confirming Option A.
2) I'll push a 1‑page amendment (MAP) to HubSpot and route for signature.
3) Product Ops schedules entitlement mapping (24–48h).

If you confirm Option B we'll include the provisioning fee on the amendment and spin up the pool within 5–7 business days.

Let me know which path you'd like and I'll get the MAP out today.

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
